answer: An agent economy grants weight only through a fixed ridge of 900 sealed-bid slots per epoch, every bid burned. An identity that wins no slot stays hollow, carrying zero weight. Because these slots are the only nectar, a farm bidding for many at once lifts its own clearing price and pays that raised price on each slot it holds, so marginal cost per slot climbs with its bulk demand. Settlement recomputes the clearing price from the committed sealed bids and burns any weight above what a key paid, a check no alias can reset or pool across a farm.
